temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated and hardworking, but he is becoming concerned that Gary's overwork is excessive and harmful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan learns that Gary's overwork is severe and that Gary is currently unwilling to step away because of hospital demands.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is significantly overworked and needs help, but he is not ready or able to accept a retreat right now.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene and find another way to support Gary's health, possibly by persuading him to rest or accept help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is severely overworked and had hoped the retreat would help Gary relax; he thinks the cause is mainly hospital obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's restless behavior, avoidance, and 'complicated' response suggest there is more to the overwork than professional obligations, and Gary may be hiding personal difficulties to avoid burdening Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There is likely a deeper, possibly personal reason behind Gary's overwork; Gary is distressed and secretive but may trust Ethan if approached gently.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary and encourage him to open up, while offering nonjudgmental support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges. Ethan suggests prioritizing tasks and delegating; Gary agrees and says he could use help organizing his schedule.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's overwork has deeper, complicated causes, but he does not yet know the specifics and thinks Gary is reluctant to burden him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now understands that Gary faces departmental pressure plus personal challenges, and that Gary is receptive to practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is driven by concrete work and personal stressors; with prioritization, delegation, and schedule organization, he can find a better balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in. Gary reports he is doing better, is less overwhelmed, and had time for a movie last weekend. Ethan sees Gary making efforts to change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is receptive to help and can improve his balance with practical support, though Gary still faces challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan sees that Gary is actually making progress and experiencing small improvements, confirming that his support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is actively improving and benefiting from support; continued encouragement will be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, encouraging Gary, and offering support as Gary works through remaining challenges.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and feels more in control. Ethan tells Gary he is always a call away and knows Gary has got this.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving with support and is on the right track, though he may still need some encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan learns that Gary has successfully adjusted and can now manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthy balance and autonomy; Ethan no longer needs to provide regular intervention, though he remains available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from regular support while letting Gary know he is still available if Gary ever needs him.
